AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION

CALL TO ORDER Vice Mayor Argumedo called the meeting to order at 5:05 pm

ROLL CALL

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS There were no individual wishing to address the City Council on any item on the Closed Session agenda. 

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION The City Council/Successor Agency recessed to Closed Session at 5:07 p.m.

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION City Council/Successor Agency reconvened to Open Session at 6:06 pm

ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT City Attorney Tapia reported on Closes Session items:

Item #1A, 1B and 1C-Staff provided a presentation, City Council provided direction and took no reportable action at this time.

Item #2 – Staff provided updates regarding the Finance Director and Library Services Director positions and no final reportable action was taken.

Item #3 – Attorney Tapia stated this is an ongoing litigation regarding construction of a structure that does not comply with the City’s Municipal Code. The City filed a lawsuit against the property owner and parties have entered into a settlement agreement, a copy of which is available in the City Clerks office. Councilmember Altamirano moved, seconded by Councilmember Lainez to approve the Settlement Agreement. The motion carried unanimously with Mayor Rebollo being absent. 

Item #4A and 4B – Staff provided a presentation City Council provided direction and took no reportable action at this time


CALL TO ORDER REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL Vice Mayor Argumedo called regular meeting to order at 7:59 p.m.

ROLL CALL

5.. Presentation/Update from the Sheriff's Department Regarding Public Safety in the City of Commerce Sergeant Duarte provided statistics for the last two weeks regarding crime numbers and arrests made 

PUBLIC COMMENT There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council or Planning Commissioners on any items at this time. 




PUBLIC HEARING

7.. Weed Abatement Program - Abatement Order Directing the Los Angeles County Agricultural Commissioners/Director of Weights and Measures to Abate Public Nuisance  -  Action: approve (Pass) Moved by Kevin Lainez Deputy City Clerk Verdin presented this item.  Vice Mayor Argumedo opened the public hearing. There were no individuals wishing to address the City Council. Vice Mayor closed the public hearing. 

8.. First Reading and Introduction of a Zoning Ordinance Text Amendment: To Amend Commerce Municipal Code, Title 19 (Zoning), Section 19.21.130 (Loading and Unloading Requirements) of the City of Commerce Municipal Code To Limit the Hours of Loading and Unloading in Manufacturing Zoned Properties when Located Within 300 Feet of Residential Zoned Properties  -  Action: approve (Pass) Moved by Ivan Altamirano Acting Director of Economic Development and PLanning Esparza provided an overview of the staff report.  City Attorney Tapia proposed revisions to the Ordinance specifically page 3 section J.

SCHEDULED MATTERS

6.. Second Amendment to the Nationwide Environmental Services Catch Basin Maintenance Agreement  -  Action: adopt (Pass) Moved by Kevin Lainez City Manager Cisneros presented this item.

ORDINANCES

9.. Second Reading and Adoption of an Ordinance Amending Commence Municipal Code, Title 9 “Peace, Safety and Morals” by Adding Chapter 9.82 “Unlawful Possession of Catalytic Converters”  -  Action: approve (Pass) Moved by Ivan Altamirano City Attorney Tapia provided an overview of the staff report.  

CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY REPORTS Councilmember Lainez thanked Amber Torres and Marcus Enriquez for facilitating the Willy Wonka production, thanked City staff for arranging a meeting with new Sheriff Robert Luna, and congratulated new Library Director Sonia Bautista

Councilmember Garcia congratulated new Library Director Sonia Bautista, reported that she attended meet & greet with Sheriff Robert Luna, district reception with Congressman Robert Garcia and attended the Wonka production where Councilmember Lainez’ son did a wonderful job. 

Vice Mayor Argumedo congratulated new Library Director Sonia Bautista, reported that he attended the Wonka production and congratulated Councilmember Lainez’ son for an outstanding job during his birthday.  Vice Mayor Argumedo expressed that the  meeting held with Sheriff Robert Luna was very successful as it allowed great follow up questions. 


ADJOURNMENT Meeting adjourned at 8:35 p.m.

Written materials distributed to the City Council are available for public inspection immediately following the posting of this agenda (at least 72 hours prior to a regular City Council meetings) in the City Clerk's Office, at Commerce City Hall, 2535 Commerce Way, Commerce, California, and the Central Library, 5655 Jillson Street, Commerce, California.

Meeting facilities are accessible to persons with disabilities. ln compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, notify the Office of the City Clerk at (323) 722-4805 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting.

City Council will recess to allow for a Joint Special Meeting of the City Council and Planning Commission City Council recessed the regular meeting and opened the Joint Special Meeting of the City Council and Planning Commission at 6:08 p.m.
